title: executive-daily-priorities-eli-2026-03-07
content:
Daily priorities - Eli Thompson - 2026-03-07

Top 3 for today (must-move):
1) Customer call prep: Redwood Retail pilot (Wed 10:30 PT) - finalize talking points and ask list.
   - Ask product/infra SLOs they want (latency percentile, throughput targets).
   - Confirm data privacy questions + on-prem option timeline.
   - Draft pricing/commit options to present (need numbers from finance).
2) Review Dedicated capacity rollout plan for EU region (internal ops sync 2pm).
   - Check ELT on autoscaling thresholds (Ravi).
   - Flag any non-compliant infra components for privacy review.
3) Exec sync with Product + Research - decision on quantization roadmap (4pm).
   - Need clear recommendation: 8-bit mixed vs 4-bit aggressive for medium-latency workloads.

Meetings (today):
- 09:00 PT: Quick 1:1 with Maya - run through Retail pilot slides (30m).
- 10:30 PT: Retail pilot customer call - main objectives + next steps (60m).
- 13:00 PT: Weekly GTM check-in (standup) - highlight Dedicated EU prep (30m).
- 14:00 PT: Ops sync on Dedicated EU region (45m) - infra owners, rollout timeline.
- 16:00 PT: Product/Research quantization decision (45m) - present recommendation.

Follow-ups / action items (by owner):
- Eli: Send Retail pilot pricing options to Finance by EOD (action: get committed monthly pricing + burst pricing).
- Maya: Share updated pilot slides + technical appendix (due 09:00).
- Ravi: Confirm GPU pool sizing & autoscale thresholds for EU Dedicated (due before 14:00 ops sync).
- Infra (@Anika): Validate network egress policy for Private deployments in EU (blockers?).
- Legal: Quick note on data residency wording for pilot contract (priority: low but call out during call).

Metrics & signals to watch (this week):
- Hosted API p50/p95 latency for text-generation across prod: ensure p95 < 450ms for 2k token window.
- Cost per 1k tokens served on Dedicated (baseline + after batching changes).
- Retail pilot traffic pattern: expected 50-200 reqs/min - ensure prefix caching settings validated.

Meeting prep notes: Retail pilot call
- Objective: align on integration plan + sign-off on pilot scope + timeline.
- 3 asks: SLOs, data handling, pricing/commit level.
- Slide order: intro (5m) -> tech approach (10m) -> infra & security (5m) -> pricing & ops (10m) -> Q&A (30m).
- Anticipated Qs:
  * Can you run inference on-prem? timeline and support model? (answer: yes; private deploy roadmap + rough ETA)
  * What are expected latency & uptime? (show p50/p95 benchmarks + fallback plan)
  * How do we handle PII? (point to KMS/HSM + audit logs + contract language)

Notes to self (scratchpad):
- Use the new benchmark slide (v3) - shows p50/p95 and cost breakdown by kernel.
- Pull recent perf numbers from observability dashboard (link in Confluence).
- Bring up model-variant routing for retail use case (fast small model for catalog queries + larger for recommendations).

Open questions / parking lot:
- Still need final decision on default quantization profile for Dedicated customers. Is the risk of quality regression acceptable at 4-bit for some model classes? (Discuss with R&D).
- Are legal and security comfortable with our proposed audit log retention for pilot? (Ping Legal).
- Should we offer limited SLA for pilots or keep pilot as non-SLA trial? pros/cons.

Quick todo checklist (tick when done):
- [ ] Finalize pilot pricing options and send to finance (Eli)
- [ ] Get updated slides from Maya (Maya)
- [ ] Confirm GPU sizing (Ravi)
- [ ] Ask Legal about residency language (Eli -> Legal)
- [ ] Post meeting notes + action items to #pilot-retail Slack channel (Eli)

Draft snippets to paste into email / Slack after customer call:
- "Thanks for the call - next steps: (1) share integration checklist by Fri, (2) schedule infra deep-dive w/ your SREs, (3) provide contract draft for pilot. We'll send pricing options by EOD. - Eli"

Context / links to reference (keep handy):
- Confluence: Redwood roadmap + Dedicated EU rollout (CONFLUENCE-12345)
- Jira: INF-1243 (Dedicated EU infra), INF-1301 (Retail pilot integration)
- GH PR: github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/PR-874 (autoscale tuning)
- Slack: #pilot-retail thread (see messages around 2026-03-05 for questions)

End-of-day wrap reminder:
- 18:00 PT: quick inbox zero + update this doc with meeting notes and action owners.

Misc scratch notes (random):
- If Finance pushes back on pricing, propose staged commit: month 1 trial free + month 2 discounted reserved capacity.
- Check if we can present a small POC with on-prem connector packaged as container (ask solutions-eng).

Last edited quick log: 09:05 - added follow-ups from sync with Maya; 09:35 - inserted ops sync items; 09:58 - final check before customer call.
